N23812822.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains joint weekly reports (“WeeKas”) on Brazilian political affairs from September 1963 to January 1964, prepared for U.S. government use. The reports track developments in the Goulart government, including political-party divisions, military activity, public responses to U.S. statements about coups, and investigations surrounding alleged plots and arms discoveries.
